Refitting

Place the vehicle on a lift.

Drain the high pressure circuit as described in the specific operation 1042A02 .

1. Drain the connector of the recharging pipe from the one-way valve on the solenoid.

2. Disconnect the connector of the recharging pipe on the connecting sleeve.

3. Release the pipe from the retaining clips (3a) and remove the pipe (3b).

If it is difficult to remove the recharging pipe, place a column jack under the petrol tank and loosen the attachment bolts slightly in order to lower the tank as much as necessary to take out the pipe.
